description: This file manages Webhook rate limiting, anomaly tracking, and WebSocket client/server cleanup for Feishu integrations, including configuration resolution and state management functions.

methods.name: coercePositiveInt
methods.description: Converts a value to a positive integer with fallback.

methods.name: resolveFeishuWebhookRateLimitDefaultsForTest
methods.description: Resolves Webhook rate limit defaults with fallback values.

methods.name: resolveFeishuWebhookAnomalyDefaultsForTest
methods.description: Resolves Webhook anomaly defaults with fallback values.

methods.name: clearFeishuWebhookRateLimitStateForTest
methods.description: Clears rate limiter and anomaly tracker states.

methods.name: getFeishuWebhookRateLimitStateSizeForTest
methods.description: Returns current size of the rate limiter state.

methods.name: isWebhookRateLimitedForTest
methods.description: Checks if a key is rate limited.

methods.name: recordWebhookStatus
methods.description: Records webhook status and logs anomalies.

methods.name: stopFeishuMonitorState
methods.description: Stops and cleans up WebSocket and HTTP server states for a given account or all.
